post_slowdown_asr_text: I raised my voice, but the beating grew louder too. I walked about and scraped my chair across the floorboards. They went on talking and smiling as before. The sound kept growing louder and louder. Could you bear that? They heard and knew! They were laughing at me! I could not stand anymore. I killed him, I screamed. Pull up the floorboards here! That is the beating of his horrible heart!
